gateSemantics.IMPLEMENTATION: Blocks business/schema changes in the specified approved scope; drafting options, read-only review and documenting decisions can proceed.
gateSemantics.VALIDATION: Blocks acceptance/completion of applicable task or artifact, not drafting the design.
gateSemantics.conditions: Resolve per task/candidate; condition false or unapproved optional scope is recorded NOT_APPLICABLE, never automatically PASS.
gateSemantics.referenceSemantics: Case decision_refs/gate_refs are trace links; enforce only its task conditional_gate_requirements plus explicitly stated joint requirements.
